questions.question: In what ratio must tea worth of Rs. 10 per kg be mixed with tea worth Rs. 15 per kg, so that the resultant mixture costs Ra.12 per kg?
questions.solution:
Given:

Tea at Rs. 10 per kg be mixed with tea at Rs. 15 per kg,

So the mixture must be worth Rs. 12 per kg.

Calculation:

Let x kg of Rs 10 per kg be mixed with y kg of tea at Rs.15 per kg .

As per the question,

10x + 15y = (x + y) 12

⇒ 10x + 15y = 12x + 12y

⇒ 2x = 3y

So, the ratio should be x : y = 3 : 2

∴ The required ration is 3:2

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of two cylinders is 13 ∶ 1 and the ratio of their heights is 13 ∶ 9. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 154 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the volume of the two cylinders is 13 ∶ 1 and the ratio of their heights is 13 ∶ 9.

The area of the base of the second cylinder is 154 cm2,

Concept used:

The volume of the cylinder = Area of base (πr²) × height(h)

Calculation: 

Let, heights are 13h and 9h.

The radius of the 1st cylinder is r

As per the question,

⇒ (πr2 × 13h) / (9h × 154) = 13

⇒ r2 = 49 × 9

⇒ r = 21

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: Mohit and Rohit undertook a work for Rs. 2200. Mohit alone can do that work in 10 days and Rohit alone can do the same work in 12 days. If they work together, then what will be the difference in the amount they receive?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Mohit and Rohit undertook work for Rs. 2200.

Mohit alone can do that work in 10 days and Rohit alone can do the same work in 12 days.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

The efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work.

Calculation:

The ratio of the number of days to complete the work is,

10: 12 = 5: 6 

The efficiency ratio will be 6:5 

Money will be distributed as per their efficiency ratio

Money received by Mohit,

⇒ 2200 × 6 / 11 = Rs 1200

Money received by Rohit,

⇒ 2200 - 1200 = Rs 1000

Difference in their share,

⇒1200 - 1000 = Rs 200

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: If the time period increases by 5 years, then simple interest increases by Rs. 3600 on a sum of Rs. 6000. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

The time period increases by 5 years, then simple interest increases by Rs. 3600 on a sum of Rs. 6000. 

Concept used:

S.I = P × R × T / 100

( P = Principal , R = Rate of interest, T = Time)

Calculation:

He received an extra Rs 3600 on a sum of Rs. 6000

which is (3600/6000) × 100 = 60%

He got 60% in 5 years

The rate of interest should be,

60 \ 5 = 12 % per year.

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: A train starts at 3:00 pm from Mumbai and moves towards Ahmedabad at the speed of 20 km/hr. Another train starts from Ahmedabad at 8 pm and moves towards Mumbai at the speed of 60 km/hr. If the distance between Mumbai and Ahmedabad is 600 km, then at what time both the trains will meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train starts at 3:00 pm from Mumbai and moves towards Ahmedabad at the speed of 20 km/hr.

Another train starts from Ahmedabad at 8 pm and moves towards Mumbai at the speed of 60 km/hr.

The distance between Mumbai and Ahmedabad is 600 km

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Concept used:**

Relative speed for opposite direction = sum of the speed given

**Calculation:**

At 8 pm the man who started at 3 pm traveled 20 × 5 = 100 km

Now distance left 600 - 100 = 500 km

Realtive speed is 20 + 60 = 80 km/hr

The time will be ,

(500 /80) = 25/ 4 hr

So will meet after 6 hr 15 minutes from 8pm

So the exact time will be 8 pm + 6 hr 15 = 2:15 am

**∴ The correct option is** **4**
